# Kawari7 Test: a synthetic Phase 7 dictionary
# no defaults for what save.txt holds: $(load) adds words to an entry, it does not replace them
system.OnLoad : $(load save.txt)$(set bootcount $(expr $(if ${bootcount} ${bootcount} 0) + 1))
system.OnUnload : $(save save.txt counter bootcount)
event.OnFirstBoot : \0\s[0]はじめまして、${system.Ghost}です。\1\s[10]ケロだよ。\e
event.OnBoot : \0\s[0]${bootcount}回目の起動です。\e
event.OnClose : \0\s[0]またね。\-\e
event.OnTest : ${system.Reference0}|${system.Reference1}|${system.Reference7}|${system.Sender}|${system.Sender.Path}|${system.EventName}\e
event.OnCount : $(set counter $(expr $(if ${counter} ${counter} 0) + 1))${counter}\e
event.OnSave : $(save save.txt counter bootcount)saved\e
event.OnTalk : $(set system.communicate ${talkto})$(set system.Response0 ソ表)話しかけ\e
talkto : おと
event.OnOther : ${system.OtherGhost}\e
system.OnTranslate : ${system.Sentence}にゃ
system.OnTeach : 教わった:${system.Sentence}\e
system.OnResponse : 返事:${system.Sentence}|${system.Sender}|${system.Age}\e
resource.homeurl : http://example.invalid/kawari7test/
resource.sakura.recommendsites : 華和梨$(chr 1)http://example.invalid/
sentence : AIトーク\e
# %ms-style words: ssp.exe asks GET Word SHIORI/2.0 with Type: \ms, Kawari 7 answers compatible.ms (no compatible.ml or m?)
compatible.ms : 鈴木
compatible.m : 何か
compatible.dms : %msの影
event.OnWords : \0%ms/%m?/%dms/%ml\e
# GET String SHIORI/2.5 for ssp.exe's other GetStringShiori reads: the tooltips and `.ext.` properties (Kawari 7
# looks up resource. + the ID with `_` as `.`, and reads no Reference there)
resource.balloon.tooltip : ${system.ID}\&[amp]tip\nline
resource.tooltip : shell-${system.ID}
resource.property.get : \&[lt]ext\&[gt]
resource.property.set : stored
